echoParts: I have told you these things
verseText: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
meaning: Jesus promised that his disciples would face tribulations (times of trouble) in this world. But we can have peace in our hearts, knowing that Jesus has earned us a place in God's forever kingdom.

recall.question: Tribulation means times of trouble or suffering. What does Jesus tell His followers to do when they face trouble?
choices: Smile and pretend nothing is wrong

meaning.question: Why can we have peace and courage even when life is difficult?

application.prompt: Jesus never promised that life would be easy, but He did promise us peace in Him! When you feel worried, hurt, or afraid, remember that Jesus has overcome the world. What is one trouble you can trust Him with today?
